answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales linearly with locked capital held within a secure vault. By requiring a costly deposit, the protocol ensures that an attacker cannot exploit a thread of malicious nodes to eclipse the network. Much like extracting shale to power energy-intensive systems, forging identities becomes prohibitively expensive, as the marginal cost of inflating power necessitates an untenable commitment of underlying assets.
